text:
If $n \in \Nat$, the corresponding \emph{Church numeral} $\num{n}$
  represents~$n$:
  \[
    \num{n} \ident \lambd[fx][f^n(x)]
  \]
  Here, $f^n(x)$ stands for the result of applying $f$ to~$x$ $n$
  times. For example, $\num{0}$ is $\lambd[fx][x]$, and $\num{3}$ is
  $\lambd[fx][f(f(f\,x))]$.
